LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 13.3.1 SENTENCES: COMPLEX SENTENCES

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.3: Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Sentences: Complex Sentences

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Sentences: Complex Sentences. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What is the role of conjunctions in sentences?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify subordinating conjunctions in sentences
2. construct complex sentences using subordinating conjunctions learnt

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify subordinating conjunctions in sentences
   In simple words: practise until you can identify subordinating conjunctions in sentences. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. construct complex sentences using subordinating conjunctions learnt
   In simple words: practise until you can construct complex sentences using subordinating conjunctions learnt. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Sentences: Complex Sentences using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Sentences: Complex Sentences in the examples.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Sentences: Complex Sentences to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Sentences: Complex Sentences.
4. Show that you can: identify subordinating conjunctions in sentences

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Sentences: Complex Sentences using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Sentences: Complex Sentences important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. In groups, use the subordinating conjunctions to make sentences and display them on a chart,
2. Join pairs of sentences using subordinating conjunctions presented in completion and substitution tables,
3. Practise punctuating complex sentences on current issues such as global sea travel,

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What is the role of conjunctions in sentences?
2. How can one differentiate between a simple and a complex sentence?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify subordinating conjunctions in sentences
2. construct complex sentences using subordinating conjunctions learnt

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
